title: Pure Mist Strawberry 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pure Mist Strawberry delivers the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries for a light and refreshing vape. This smooth and simple e-liquid is ideal for vapers who enjoy classic, fruity flavours with a natural profile. The Pure Mist High-PG collection offers tailored VG/PG ratios to suit different vaping preferences. The 3mg nicotine strength features a 50VG/50PG blend for balanced vapour and flavour production, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths use a high-PG 30VG/70PG ratio for a more intense flavour profile with discreet vapour. Designed for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices, Pure Mist Strawberry is crafted in the UK with premium ingredients to ensure consistent quality and satisfaction.
